description: This file defines two simple methods related to rental products and fixed assets within the OFBiz framework, including creation and retrieval functions.

methods.name: createFixedAssetAndLinkToProduct
methods.description: Creates a fixed asset and links it to a product, used when an asset usage product is created.

methods.name: getProductFirstRelatedFixedAsset
methods.description: Retrieves the first fixed asset associated with a rental product, assuming one-to-one relation.
